description_for_human: Accept payments, issue refunds, create invoices, and manage payouts using Razorpay — India's leading payment platform.
description_for_model: Use Razorpay to create payment orders and links, fetch payment status, issue full or partial refunds, create payouts to bank accounts or UPI, and generate invoices. Supports INR and 120+ international currencies. Authentication uses API key (Basic Auth with key_id:key_secret). Sandbox available at https://api.razorpay.com/v1 with test keys.
